concertdef_sbom_examples.overview: Complete examples demonstrating how to generate ConcertDef SBOM files from various vulnerability scan reports.

example.name: trivy_container_scan
example.description: Generate SBOM from Trivy container image scan report
example.scenario: User provides a Trivy JSON scan report for a container image and wants to generate a ConcertDef SBOM for upload to IBM Concert.

step.extract: - ArtifactName (image name) - Metadata.RepoTags (image tags) - Metadata.RepoDigests (SHA256 digest) - Results[].Target (scan target)

step.action: Add container component from Trivy data

example.name: multiple_scan_reports
example.description: Generate SBOM from multiple scan reports (Trivy + Snyk)

step.extract: Image name, tag, digest, base image
Package names, versions, package manager type

step.note: Create single build component containing both container and library components

step.structure: - Build component (top level) - Container component (from Trivy) - Library components (from Snyk) - Code repository component

example.name: documentation_template
example.markdown_template:
# ConcertDef SBOM Generation Report
## Application Information - **Name**: [Application Name] - **Version**: [Version] - **Generated**: [Timestamp]
## Scan Reports Analyzed | Scanner | Version | Report File | Scan Date | |---------|---------|-------------|-----------| | Trivy | v0.48.0 | trivy-report.json | 2024-12-06 | | Snyk | v1.1234.0 | snyk-report.json | 2024-12-06 |
## Components Identified ### Containers - **us.icr.io/acme/my-app:1.0.0** - Digest: sha256:abc123... - Base Image: ubi9 - Source: Trivy scan
### Code Repositories - **github.com/acme/my-app** - Commit: a1b2c3d4... - Branch: main - Source: Repository metadata
### Libraries - **express@4.18.2** (npm) - **lodash@4.17.21** (npm) - Source: Snyk dependency scan
## Environments - **dev**: Development environment (Kubernetes) - **prod**: Production environment (Kubernetes)
## Services - **my-app-api**: REST API service - Endpoints: /api/v1, /health - Exposure: Public
## Assumptions and Decisions 1. Used current timestamp for SBOM generation 2. Inferred environment names from standard conventions 3. Mapped container to service based on naming patterns 4. Business unit information provided by user
## Validation Results ✓ Schema compliance verified ✓ All bom-ref values are unique ✓ All dependency references are valid ✓ Required fields present ✓ JSON syntax valid
## Upload Instructions 1. Log in to IBM Concert 2. Navigate to Application SBOMs section 3. Click "Upload SBOM" 4. Select the generated file: `my-app-sbom.json` 5. Verify upload success
## Generated Files - `my-app-sbom.json` - ConcertDef SBOM file - `sbom-generation-report.md` - This documentation

example.name: error_handling
example.description: How to handle common issues during SBOM generation

scenario.name: missing_digest
scenario.problem: Container image digest not found in scan report
scenario.solution: 1. Check if scan report includes image metadata 2. Look for RepoDigests or similar fields 3. If unavailable, document in generation report 4. Consider re-scanning with digest capture enabled

scenario.name: unknown_scanner_format
scenario.solution: 1. Examine JSON structure to identify key fields 2. Look for common patterns (artifacts, vulnerabilities, packages) 3. Extract component information manually 4. Document the custom parsing approach 5. Ask user for clarification if needed

scenario.name: missing_business_info
scenario.solution: 1. Use ask_followup_question to request organization name 2. Provide example format 3. Explain importance for IBM Concert 4. Use placeholder if user cannot provide, with documentation

scenario.name: duplicate_components
scenario.problem: Same component appears in multiple scan reports
scenario.solution: 1. Identify duplicates by comparing identifiers 2. Merge information from all sources 3. Prefer more detailed/recent information 4. Document which reports contributed to final component
